description: This file declares the RemotePlugin class within the WPEFramework::Plugin::Rust namespace. It implements the Rust::IPlugin interface and provides methods for plugin lifecycle management, communication, and interaction with the plugin host. The class manages remote process launching, socket communication, and callback handling, tailored for integrating Rust components into the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: RemotePlugin
classes.description: A plugin class that interfaces with Rust components, manages remote processes, and handles communication via sockets within the WPEFramework environment.
